power.name: And They Shall Know No Fear
power.description: Begin play with the feats Jaded and Fearless (Angry).

power.name: Warp Miasma
power.description: As a half action, create a 4m radius sphere of darkness. Blocks line of effect; anyone within is blind. Lasts one round per level. Uses: 1/scene at L1, 2/scene at L3, 3/scene at L5.

power.name: Dragon Breath
power.description: Once per scene, make an attack with your breath weapon using the same weapon profile as a Flamer. At Level 3 and 5 you gain an additional use per scene.

power.name: Warp Step
power.description: Once per scene, teleport up to twice your speed as a half action. You must be able to see your destination. At Level 3 and 5 you gain an additional use per scene.

power.name: Elven Accuracy
power.description: Once per scene, reroll a failed Weaponry or Ballistic skill Test. At Level 3 and 5 you gain an additional use per scene.

power.name: Improvise
power.description: Begin play with one free Weapon proficiency of any type and one free Armor proficiency of any type.

power.name: Shifty
power.description: Static Defense = 10 + (6 × Dexterity) - (2 × Size). Uses only Dexterity instead of Wisdom + Dexterity.

power.name: Heroic Heritage
power.description: Begin play with one additional Hero Point.

power.name: WAAAAAGH!
power.description: At the beginning of each combat, heal hit points equal to your level.

power.name: Squat Toughness
power.description: Resilience is treated as one higher for determining hit points lost due to damage.

power.name: Fall Back
power.description: Whenever you successfully dodge a melee attack, you may make a free withdraw action (half normal distance).

power.name: Bloody Minded
power.description: You may reroll damage dice that land on a 1.

power.name: Multi-Armed
power.description: Smaller pair of arms allow taking a Ready action as a free action once per round and reload weapons in half the listed time.

power.name: Wing-Aided Movement
power.description: Do not suffer from falling damage as long as they can unfurl wings. Fall only 2m per round and can glide horizontally at normal speed. +2k0 to all Acrobatics tests.

power.name: The Blood
power.description: Once per round as a Free Action, spend two Hit Points to gain a Resource Point which must be immediately spent. This does not count against Resource Points per round limit.

power.name: Dryad Power (choose one)
power.description: Choose either Pheromone Pollen or Not An Animal.

options.name: Pheromone Pollen
options.description: Produce pollen that subtly affects minds. Duplicate effects of the Attraction spell using Level + Fellowship in place of a Focus Power test.

options.name: Not An Animal
options.description: Immune to Toxic, Shocking weapon attributes, and drug effects/addictions. Take an extra wound from fire and must make Fear(1) test when someone tries to set you on fire. Gain one less insanity point than normal (minimum zero).
